all: ICBC provides ₩625 billion loan to Shanghai Automotive Industry Corporation for the Ssangyong Motor Company Acquisition Project
Bank of China provides a $500 million USD loan to Hyundai Motor Group for its business development
China Eximbank provides a $450 million USD loan to Minsheng Financial Leasing for the purchase of two Airbus A380-800 aircraft to lease to Asiana Airlines
ICBC Leasing enters into a sale-and-leaseback agreement worth $437 million USD with Asiana Airlines for one Airbus A320neo and three Airbus A350-900 aircraft
Bank of China provides $179.55 million USD buyer’s credit loan to STX Pan Ocean to finance the construction of three bulk carriers
ICBC contributes to a ₩800 billion KRW syndicated loan to LG Display for capital expenditures purposes
Bank of China provides a $120 million USD loan to Woori Bank for unspecified purposes
ICBC Aviation Leasing enters into a sale-and-leaseback agreement worth $154 million USD with Korean Air for one Boeing 787-9 aircraft
Bank of Communications provides ₩150 billion KRW revolving credit facility to Hyundai Capital Services for liquidity purposes
ICBC contributes $100 million USD to a $402.72 million USD syndicated loan to Samsung Heavy Industries for drillship acquisition purposes
